INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
(
                ACCOUNT_STATUS
                ,ADB
                ,ADB_UPD_DT
                ,ALIAS
                ,BRANCH_CD
                ,CIF
                ,CORP_ID
                ,CURRENCY_CD
                ,DEL
                ,EXTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,HOST_NAME
                ,ID
                ,INTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,IS_OWN
                ,NAME
                ,NO
                ,LAST6_NO
                ,OUT_DT
                ,PREV_STATUS
                ,REF_NO
                ,SS_DT
                ,STATUS
                ,TYPE_CD
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_DT
                ,VCN
                ,VERSION
                ,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG 
				,JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.ACCOUNT_STATUS
                ,CC.ADB
                ,CC.ADB_UPD_DT
                ,CC.ALIAS
                ,CC.BRANCH_CD
                ,CC.CIF
                ,CC.CORP_ID
                ,CC.CURRENCY_CD
                ,CC.DEL
                ,CC.EXTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,CC.HOST_NAME
                ,CC.ID
                ,CC.INTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,CC.IS_OWN
                ,CC.NAME
                ,CC.NO
                ,CC.LAST6_NO
                ,CC.OUT_DT
                ,CC.PREV_STATUS
                ,CC.REF_NO
                ,CC.SS_DT
                ,CC.STATUS
                ,CC.TYPE_CD
                ,CC.UPDATED_BY
                ,CC.UPDATED_DT
                ,CC.VCN
                ,CC.VERSION
                ,CC.FILE_NAME
		        ,0 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT CC
            JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT B
            ON CC.ID  = B.ID 
            AND LEFT(CC.FILE_NAME, 5) = LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5)
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';
	


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC
(

select 
                ACCOUNT_STATUS
                ,ADB
                ,ADB_UPD_DT
                ,ALIAS
                ,BRANCH_CD
                ,CIF
                ,CORP_ID
                ,CURRENCY_CD
                ,DEL
                ,EXTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,HOST_NAME
                ,ID
                ,INTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,IS_OWN
                ,NAME
                ,NO
                ,LAST6_NO
                ,OUT_DT
                ,PREV_STATUS
                ,REF_NO
                ,SS_DT
                ,STATUS
                ,TYPE_CD
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_DT
                ,VCN
                ,VERSION
				,FILE_NAME
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                ACCOUNT_STATUS
                ,ADB
                ,ADB_UPD_DT
                ,ALIAS
                ,BRANCH_CD
                ,CIF
                ,CORP_ID
                ,CURRENCY_CD
                ,DEL
                ,EXTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,HOST_NAME
                ,ID
                ,INTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,IS_OWN
                ,NAME
                ,NO
                ,LAST6_NO
                ,OUT_DT
                ,PREV_STATUS
                ,REF_NO
                ,SS_DT
                ,STATUS
                ,TYPE_CD
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_DT
                ,VCN
                ,VERSION
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                ACCOUNT_STATUS
                ,ADB
                ,ADB_UPD_DT
                ,ALIAS
                ,BRANCH_CD
                ,CIF
                ,CORP_ID
                ,CURRENCY_CD
                ,DEL
                ,EXTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,HOST_NAME
                ,ID
                ,INTERNAL_REMARKS
                ,IS_OWN
                ,NAME
                ,NO
                ,LAST6_NO
                ,OUT_DT
                ,PREV_STATUS
                ,REF_NO
                ,SS_DT
                ,STATUS
                ,TYPE_CD
                ,UPDATED_BY
                ,UPDATED_DT
                ,VCN
                ,VERSION
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND COALESCE(LEFT(A.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1') = COALESCE(LEFT(B.FILE_NAME, 5),'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

                ,SRC.OUT_DT
                ,SRC.PREV_STATUS
                ,SRC.REF_NO
                ,SRC.SS_DT
                ,SRC.STATUS
                ,SRC.TYPE_CD
                ,SRC.UPDATED_BY
                ,SRC.UPDATED_DT
                ,SRC.VCN
                ,SRC.VERSION
				,SRC.FILE_DATE
				,'9999-12-31'
				,1
				,1
				,LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME, 5)
				,'BOB'
				,SRC.FILE_NAME
				,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
